name: When should I consider replacing my toilet instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my toilet instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your toilet if it's constantly running, frequently clogs, has visible cracks in the porcelain, or if the repairs are becoming more expensive than a new unit. Toilets older than 20 years may also lack water-saving features, making a replacement a practical tradeoff for long-term water bill savings. We often see older models in Las Vegas properties that are less efficient, making a new installation a wise choice for both functionality and utility costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your toilet if it has constant issues like running or clogging, visible cracks, or if repair costs exceed a new unit's price. Older models are often less water-efficient.
